definition.def: Your motivation for doing something is what causes you to want to do it.
examples: The timing of the attack, and its motivations, are unknown.

definition.def: If you are motivated by something, especially an emotion, it causes you to behave in a particular way.
examples: They are motivated by a need to achieve. [be VERB-ed]
The crime was not politically motivated. [be VERB-ed]
I don't want to be missing out. And that motivates me to get up and do something every day. [VERB noun to-infinitive]

definition.def: If someone motivates you to do something, they make you feel determined to do it.
examples: How do you motivate people to work hard and efficiently? [VERB noun to-infinitive]
Never let it be said that the manager doesn't know how to motivate his players. [VERB noun]

examples.sentence: Too much dependence on the teacher risks loss of autonomy and motivation to discover.
Creativity in all forms can be seen as expertise mixed with a high level of motivation (Weisberg, 1993).
This was succinctly summarized by Michel et al. (2013): "Providing support to employees gives them the confidence to perform their jobs better and the motivation to stay with the organization."
Hospitality organizations can therefore enhance employee motivation and retention through the development and improvement of their working conditions.
Herzberg (1966) proposes that people have two major types of needs, the first being extrinsic motivation factors relating to the context in which work is performed, rather than the work itself.
Employees also have intrinsic motivation needs or motivators, which include such factors as achievement and recognition.
As much as I'd love to help develop a groundbreaking insect-derived medicine, my main motivation for looking at insects in this way is conservation.
Similarly, Miller and Almon (2009) say that play includes "activities that are freely chosen and directed by children and arise from intrinsic motivation".
At this mid-point between play and work, the child's motivation, coupled with guidance from an adult, can create robust opportunities for playful learning.
To stand up in a classroom and successfully deliver a good speech is a genuine achievement, and that is likely to be more powerfully motivating than vague notions of 'motivation' itself.
